June 10th John Butler - 65 - asthma bad ...

15th E'd Nugent - 47 - trying to overcome drink
17 Mary Allen - 80 - next Xmas - Stroke 5 yrs ago - is very
18 Mrs. Mattie Reed - 39 - colored - Arthritis
Mrs. Clara Boesenberger - 67 - operated on for Cancer May 22 - very poorly Today Helena Pienta - 47 - 3 operation
W. Dillen - 46 - Blood poison badly. ...
Page 284 June Magdelena Eppich - 83 - in Austria asks for prayers - seemingly al- most starving. Had five sons in last war - one killed - one wounded and + here two years later.
Thomas Huld - 36 - Enemia. Eliz. Hild - elderly - looking for two rooms - unfurnished Tr. 1572 Mrs. Frances Drago - 44 - dropsey and liver - 44
22 John E. Little - 45 - poisoned kidnies - has family of four to care for.
23 Thanks - Marg. Ann White - 9 - went to hospital in Kalamazoo - tuomer on brain - pneumonia and paralyzed; that was on Ash Wednesday - was unconscious for Exactly 8 week ..... is here To-day bright and alert learning to walk again. (Nov. 14th Margaret pronounced cured - now going to school) (See Ist note March 5)
